result.summary: No overdue notifications are currently open for Qasr Meridian Trading LLC. The last two resolved overdues (Apr-2026, Aug-2026) show days-late shrinking from 11 to 6 days, reported by a single policyholder with no sign of notifications piling up across policies or periods. The sole credit line (TCI, USD 1.8M, 90-day terms) remains accepted and was last reviewed Mar-2026.
concerns: Only two historical data points, so the improving trend should be confirmed with further observations before relying on it heavily.
All exposure and notification history comes from a single insurer (TCI) on one policy, limiting visibility into the buyer's broader payment behaviour.
